purpose.claimLimit: Practice only; not a CEFR assessment, independent reading task, or validated learning intervention.
responseModes: say the word if the child chooses

facilitation.en: Say one English cue, then pause. Let the child point, tap, gesture, or listen. Name the picture together; do not require the child to say the word.
facilitation.vi: Nói một câu gợi ý tiếng Anh rồi chờ. Hãy để trẻ chỉ, chạm, ra hiệu hoặc chỉ lắng nghe. Cùng gọi tên hình; không bắt trẻ phải nói theo.
facilitation.presentation: Show three large, unlabeled picture cards for one item. Keep the answer key and word labels out of the child's view. The adult may use the Vietnamese cue as support.
facilitation.feedback: Use warm, neutral feedback and allow another try without a timer or score.
facilitation.runtime: Staging concept only; requires an image-capable activity renderer and reviewed illustrations before implementation.

provenance.usage: Target words are drawn from original Atlas A1 contexts; only the concepts are reused. New cues and image descriptions are original.

provenance.title: Common European Framework of Reference for Languages: Learning, teaching, assessment – Companion volume
provenance.usage: Reference only for CEFR reading and young-learner descriptor scope; no descriptors reproduced.

provenance.title: Literacy Promotion: An Essential Component of Primary Care Pediatric Practice: Policy Statement
provenance.usage: Reference only for shared-reading and dialogic-reading design context; no text reproduced.

adultCue.vi: Con tìm chiếc đèn lồng nhé?

visualOptions.concept: One hanging paper lantern with a simple shape on a plain background.
One small blue boat, shown alone on a plain background.
One open seashell, shown alone on a plain background.

parentFacilitation.en: Invite the child to point first; then name the lantern together.
parentFacilitation.vi: Mời trẻ chỉ vào hình trước, rồi cùng gọi tên chiếc đèn lồng.

visualOptions.concept: One small silver hand bell with a visible handle, shown alone on a plain background.
One open seashell, shown alone on a plain background.
One broad green leaf, shown alone on a plain background.

parentFacilitation.en: Let the child point, tap, or make a ringing gesture; model the word without asking for repetition.
parentFacilitation.vi: Để trẻ chỉ, chạm hoặc làm điệu bộ rung chuông; nói mẫu từ này mà không yêu cầu trẻ lặp lại.

visualOptions.concept: One small blue harbor boat with a clear hull shape, shown alone on a plain background.
One colorful paper kite with a visible tail, shown alone on a plain background.
One hanging paper lantern, shown alone on a plain background.

parentFacilitation.en: If useful, point out how the boat moves on water; keep the child's choice open.
parentFacilitation.vi: Nếu thấy hữu ích, hãy nói thuyền đi trên nước; để trẻ tự chọn.

adultCue.vi: Con tìm chiếc vỏ sò nhé?

visualOptions.concept: One white seashell with a simple spiral, shown alone on a plain background.
One small silver hand bell, shown alone on a plain background.
One broad green leaf, shown alone on a plain background.

parentFacilitation.en: Invite the child to point or pretend to hold the shell; share its name together.
parentFacilitation.vi: Mời trẻ chỉ hoặc giả vờ cầm vỏ sò; cùng gọi tên vật.

visualOptions.concept: One diamond-shaped paper kite with a long tail, shown against a simple sky.
One small blue boat, shown alone on a plain background.
One hanging paper lantern, shown alone on a plain background.

parentFacilitation.en: Ask what the child notices about the kite or its tail; accept pointing or talk in either language.
parentFacilitation.vi: Hỏi trẻ nhận ra điều gì ở con diều hoặc chiếc đuôi; chấp nhận trẻ chỉ hoặc nói bằng ngôn ngữ nào cũng được.

visualOptions.concept: One broad green leaf with a simple stem and outline, shown alone on a plain background.
One open seashell, shown alone on a plain background.
One colorful paper kite with a visible tail, shown alone on a plain background.

parentFacilitation.en: Invite the child to find a leaf nearby too, if one is available; the picture choice is enough.
parentFacilitation.vi: Nếu có lá ở gần, mời trẻ tìm thêm; chỉ chọn hình cũng đã đủ.

limitations: No children or families have tried these items.
No illustrations or audio files are included or rights-cleared by this sample.
The sample has no CEFR level and provides no language-placement, learning-gain, or proficiency evidence.
